capabilities: record the scroll position of each Markdown file automatically
restore the exact scroll position when switching back to a file
hide the flicker and jump during file switches
suppress editor focus shifts that cause secondary scrolling
clean up stored positions when files are renamed or deleted
disambiguation: Not a cursor-position or workspace-layout saver; it only remembers and restores the scroll offset of files.
extras: The README is bilingual (Simplified Chinese and English). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs include installation steps but no screenshots or configuration details; the author says it works without configuration.
problem: Obsidian forgets the scroll position of a file after switching, so returning to a long note drops the reader back at the top with visible flickering and jumping.
summary: Scroll position plugin that records where each Markdown file was scrolled and restores that exact position when the file is reopened.
